statement: We set `KAFKA_CONSUMER_MAX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=300000` for the tracking-ingest group, but long message-processing pauses still triggered consumer rebalances, so this is ruled out. Increase `max_poll_interval_ms` to 300000 in tracking-ingest now.
